_why: Single-system-message assembly vectors (Ek O 8). Generated by the backend (backend/prompt_layer.py + routers/completions._assemble_messages) with salt and nonce written as zeros of their real length. Backend test drives the real endpoint and compares; frontend/src/lib/prompt/assembly.ts must produce the same system text and the same fixed cost. A case may carry `triggers`, one list per module (the generations it fires on); without it every module fires on an ordinary send. a-enabled-not-sent holds Ek O 7: an enabled module that does not fire on this send still turns the layer off. b-blank-module-is-not-on holds the one "is this module on" predicate (store.block_reason / assembly.ts moduleFires): a module that is blank by the sanitizer table whitespace set is not on, so the layer stays. module_fires is that predicate case by case: content (or `repeat` x `times`), triggers, fires.
